title: Frontend: Longest Substring No Repeats
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Longest Substring No Repeats. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(text). Return length in Unicode code points of the longest contiguous substring without repeated code points.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Use a sliding window and a map of each symbol’s most recent position.
alternativeApproaches: Return the actual substring while preserving correct offsets when iterating Unicode code points.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: All unique; all same; repeated symbol outside current window.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
